gen-gf-turret-road-gf-almarai: A pen-like line of constant weight gives Turret Road its bold, commanding presence in round, parenthesis-like curves. And Almarai, with sans-serif strokes that never pinch shut, leaves Turret Road to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-amarna: Commanding and round, Turret Road leads with a pen-like stroke. Beneath it, Amarna's contrast-free strokes and unclogged small counters make a quiet, clean sans-serif partner for that pen-like line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-andika: Round, parenthesis-like curves and a pen-like line of constant weight give Turret Road its bold, commanding voice. Andika, in sans-serif, handles the quiet work, with generous s turns and terminals matching its stems.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bai-jamjuree: Turret Road looks like an announcement, its rounded letters drawn in a pen-like line of constant weight, bold and commanding. Bai Jamjuree handles the explaining, approachable, light in its rounds, unmodulated.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Fine rope laid into letter shapes: that is Turret Road, commanding and round. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std carries on gently line after line, its sans-serif curves swelling like hand-drawn ink.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-chakra-petch: Rounded, bold, commanding: Turret Road draws it all in one pen-like line. Chakra Petch backs the heading with cupped, unclenched rounds and one steady stroke width, a quiet counterweight.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans-expand: A pen-like line of constant weight gives Turret Road its bold, commanding look, with unmodulated outlines. But shrink the heading and its punch fades, while Encode Sans Expanded, c tips pulled well apart, would hold up large.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-fahkwang: Turret Road looks laser-cut from sheet, round and commanding, every line held to a single stroke width. Fahkwang, mildly swelling like worn felt marker, keeps long reading approachable.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-finlandica: Turret Road lays down bold, commanding letters in a pen-like line of constant weight, curving generously. And Finlandica, its e crossbars open-mouthed, takes up the thread with a constant-width outline, so both fonts keep to a single line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gruppo: Turret Road gives every line a smooth, tube-like look, round and bold with a commanding pen-like stroke. Gruppo, professional and clean, lets its curve endings stay far apart, giving the heading room to command.
